_documentation.description: Example UI config for IPWall. Copy this file to ui_config.json and customize values.
_documentation.environment: Set UI_CONFIG_FILE to the in-container path (default: config/ui_config.json).

ssh_targets_fields.name: Required. Human-readable target label shown in UI.
ssh_targets_fields.enabled: Optional boolean (default: true). Disabled targets are ignored.
ssh_targets_fields.remote_host: Required for remote sync. DNS name or IP.
ssh_targets_fields.remote_user: Required for remote sync. SSH username.
ssh_targets_fields.remote_script: Optional path to remote sync script (default: /usr/local/bin/ipwall-remote-sync).

service_links_fields.heading: Required. Group title shown on dashboard.
service_links_fields.icon: Optional. Emoji/text or static asset path under src/static/ (e.g. icons/app1.png).
service_links_fields.links: Required array of link items. Invalid rows are ignored.

service_link_item_fields.label: Required. Link display text.
service_link_item_fields.icon: Optional. Emoji/text or static asset path under src/static/.
service_link_item_fields.copyable: Optional boolean. Show copy-to-clipboard button when true.
service_link_item_fields.helper_text: Optional text shown above URL for extra context.

links.label: Apps or Browser
links.helper_text: Apps must use this link to connect
